title.text:
The new earth
Behold, I create new heavens and a new earth.  Isaiah 65:17
...and there was no more sea.  Revelation 21:1

hint: E: talk with someone nearby    Esc: menu
zones: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it... and the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day.  Rev 21:24-25
And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.  Isa 65:21
The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock... They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain.  Isa 65:25
The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together.  Isa 11:6
And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.  Isa 11:7
For in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.  Isa 35:6
They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat... mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.  Isa 65:22
default_zone: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.  Isa 35:1

Ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace... and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.  Isa 55:12
For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.  Isa 65:17
And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it.  Rev 21:24
